rationale: The bid-ask spread of 185 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday trading, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that would require a significant move just to break even. Volume is elevated (4.14x relative) but the price action is erratic and the 9-EMA sits well above current price, suggesting the gap-up momentum has faded without a clean setup in either direction.
